code.text: Type 1 diabetes — elevated periodontal, infection, and impaired-healing risk. Coordinate dental care with diabetes management.

note.text: Active systemic-disease risk signal (not just problem-list history) raised at referral by Dr. Smith, referencing the pre-existing Condition/condition-e10-9-diabetes. This is the diabetes -> periodontal-risk direction; a distinct periodontal -> glycemic-risk Flag to the endocrinologist is a separate resource built at Interaction 4 (not here) — the two must not be conflated.
